resolved.title: 自定义数据结构
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]User-Defined Data Structures[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In the previous modules we have seen the built-in data structures in Python, which include [b]Lists[/b], [b]Dictionaries[/b], [b]Tuples[/b] and [b]Sets[/b].

Some applications require additional functionality when working with data, for example, word processors have an undo-redo function, task schedulers need queuing mechanisms, maps need to find the shortest path, etc.
In these cases we need to define our own data structures that provide the required functionality. 

Some of the most popular data structures are:
 - [b]Stacks[/b]
 - [b]Queues[/b]
 - [b]Linked Lists[/b]
 - [b]Graphs[/b]

[note]We will implement the above data structures and use them to solve popular problems.[/note]

content.text:
在前面的模块中，我们已经看到了Python中内置的数据结构，其中包括 **列表** 、**字典**、**元组** 和 **集合** 。

一些应用程序在处理数据时需要额外的功能，例如，文字处理器有一个撤销-重做功能，任务调度器需要排队机制，地图需要找到最短路径，等等。
在这些情况下，我们需要定义自己的数据结构，提供所需的功能。

一些常见的数据结构：

 - **堆栈**
 - **队列**
 - **链表**
 - **图Graph**
content.text_html:
In the previous modules we have seen the built-in data structures in Python, which include Lists, Dictionaries, Tuples and Sets.

Some applications require additional functionality when working with data, for example, word processors have an undo-redo function, task schedulers need queuing mechanisms, maps need to find the shortest path, etc. In these cases we need to define our own data structures that provide the required functionality.

Some of the most popular data structures are:

  • Stacks
  • Queues
  • Linked Lists
  • Graphs

  • 堆栈
  • 队列
